definitions.explanation: A selection of different items brought together, or the way things are combined or matched. Often used in food, fashion, and artistic contexts to describe how elements complement each other.

examples.japanese: ⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{果物|くだもの}→果物：00509_kudamono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{取|と}り{合|あ}わせ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}した→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧。
examples.english: I ordered an assortment of seasonal fruits.

examples.japanese: ⟦{和菓子|わがし}→和菓子：04962_wagashi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{抹茶|まっちゃ}→抹茶：10574_maccha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最高|さいこう}→最高：02637_saikou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{取|と}り{合|あ}わせだ。
examples.english: Japanese sweets and matcha are the perfect pairing.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used to describe aesthetic or culinary pairings. In traditional Japanese arts such as tea ceremony and flower arrangement, the choice of {取|と}り{合|あ}わせ reflects seasonal awareness and artistic sensibility.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{取|と}り{合|あ}わせ (color combination)
- ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{取|と}り{合|あ}わせ (food assortment)
- {取|と}り{合|あ}わせ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧ (a good combination)
- {取|と}り{合|あ}わせ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (a poor combination)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{組|く}み{合|あ}わせ→組み合わせ：13794_kumiawase⟧: combination — more general, often used for pairings in competitions or technical contexts
- ⟦{盛|も}り{合|あ}わせ→盛り合わせ：21762_moriawase⟧: assorted platter — specifically a dish with an assortment of foods
